'''Bon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] who lived on [[Almas]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
When some warehouses in [[Forard]] on Almas were covered in anti-[[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren]] graffiti, Bon and fellow Bothan [[Illy]] were hired to guard them, despite the fact that neither of them had any previous security experience. They were not very professional and spent the time playing games on their [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]].
